calculation_handling.description: Scope statement: Article 10.10.60 applies to ancillary buildings or structures in the R zone that are ancillary to dwelling units or residential buildings, in addition to Article 10.5.60.
calculation_handling.gaps: Scope only; Article 10.5.60 continues to apply alongside.

10.10.60.1(1).explanation: The R-zone rules for garages, sheds and other ancillary buildings serving homes apply on top of the general ancillary-building rules in Article 10.5.60.
